style: Wide cinematic YouTube channel banner background, photorealistic still life, dramatic film noir lighting with warm gold and deep crimson accents on dark wood, soft film grain, absolutely no text, no letters, no logos, no faces. The CENTER third of the frame must stay dark, calm and empty (soft blurred shadow) so a title can be placed there. Objects arranged as a story from left to right along the bottom and the edges.

images.prompt: LOVE on the far left: two gold wedding rings beside a single red rose and a wedding photo. AFFAIR at left-center edge: a wine glass with a red lipstick mark and a hotel room key. BETRAYAL at right-center edge: a torn couple photograph and a cracked phone glowing with an unread message. REVENGE on the far right: legal documents with a fountain pen, a judge's gavel, and a broken champagne glass. Candlelight.

Far left: a bride's veil and a red rose on a chair. Left edge: a man's white shirt collar with a red lipstick stain beside a woman's earring. Right edge: a torn wedding photograph and a sealed envelope with red wax. Far right: a signed contract, a gavel and a shattered wine glass with spilled red wine. Moody candlelight, rain on a window in the dark background.

Silhouette drama: far left a couple embracing in silhouette under warm golden light (love); left edge a woman's silhouette watching through rain-streaked glass (jealousy); right edge a man's silhouette walking away with a suitcase (betrayal); far right a woman's silhouette standing tall in front of a courthouse with columns (revenge, justice). Center dark and empty, deep shadows, warm gold and crimson rim light. No faces visible, silhouettes only.
